decisions.what: Quota rule read as: stop at 12 points of claude weekly (and of fable weekly) spent; pause new runs while the 5 h window is below 25% left
decisions.why: Brief rule 6. Pausing keeps 25% of the window free without ending the round early; the weekly cap ends the runs.

decisions.what: Split train/val/test 12/12/12, stratified by tag, seed 20261012
decisions.why: Same design as round 1; levers are judged on val with 3 trials (brief step 3).

decisions.what: Judge negatives: 12 known-bad replies (empty, I don't know, wrong numbers or facts) on lk05, lk09, nm01, nm06 all got correct=0 (r2/judge_negatives.json).

Grader fixes after the baseline val run, applied to recorded rows with run.py --regrade before any lever ran: (1) no_latex no longer fires on currency pairs such as '$5/TB ... $10/TB' (ed09, 2 rows); (2) ed09 scope also allows BENCHMARK_CHECK.md and scripts/validate_ceridwen_speedups.py, which state the same bandwidth limit; (3) the graded reply is the trailing assistant messages after the last tool result, not only the result event, which held a one-line note after a background task ended (lk09 rep0; re-judged).
nm06 key kept unchanged although all 3 baseline reps fail it (no 3342 fitted-pixel count; the judge requires the ln Z non-comparability point). Not tuned after seeing results.

Measured cost of baseline val x3 (36 runs): weekly 96 -> 92, weekly_fable 100 -> 97, 5 h 87 -> 33. About 5 pp weekly remain above the 87 floor: lever order sonnet, effort-high, review, fable (fable would need about 18 pp of the fable pool). Gate floors raised to weekly 88 / 5 h 31 to absorb runs in flight.

Hand labels (agent-labelled; none from Liu Hao) on the 12 judged baseline val rows: correct agrees 9/12 before and 12/12 after the nm06 key named its required facts; adjacent_n within 1 on 8/12, judge higher by 1.25 on average (r2/judge_agreement.json). The nm06 key change is applied to every variant with run.py --regrade --cases nm06.
no_latex: the digit-led $...$ branch now needs a backslash, ^ or _{ and never spans a code span (MAX_INET_COST_USD_PER_TB matched). Round-1 replies give the same result with the old and new pattern.

Baseline val x3 after the grader fixes: outcome, pass and rules 1.000 on 36/36 runs. Val cannot show an improvement; levers are compared on losses, counts and cost. Lever order kept: sonnet, effort-high, then review/fable only if quota remains.
